note: Classical objection: the quarta via applies a principle about what is maximal 'in a genus' to being, but being is not a genus. It succeeds only on the strict reading of 'genus' (QUARTA-VIA-STRICT-GENUS-READING-FAILS); on the broad reading used by the corpus it does not refute the premise (QUARTA-VIA-BROAD-GENUS-COMPATIBLE-WITH-BEING-NOT-A-GENUS). See DISAMB-GENUS.
